Measurement software / Overview

Spectrum analyzer platform

An analysis environment for swept and real-time spectrum workflows, modulation measurements and inspection of IQ data.

SA / RTSALTE / NRIQ analysis

Engineering scope

This area of work connects signal acquisition with spectrum and modulation analysis. The interface needs to expose measurement settings and help engineers inspect the data behind a displayed result.

Workflow priorities

  • Acquisition context. Keep capture settings visible alongside analysis.
  • Signal inspection. Support spectrum workflows and deeper examination of IQ data.
  • Measurement clarity. Present results with the configuration needed to interpret them.
